00:01:56,840

Hello, Winsham Farm Centre.

00:01:59,600

Oh, hello. I want to arrange a weekend away for myself and some people from work, and we heard about your centre. I wonder if you could give me some details.

00:02:09,880

Yes, certainly. Uh, we are a residential centre attached to a working farm, and we organize educational activities for those guests who want them.

00:02:20,500

Um, what else would you like to know?

00:02:23,300

Well, firstly, what kind of accommodation have you got?

00:02:27,040

We've got eight rooms altogether, and we can sleep 38 at any one time. Three of the rooms have got 6 bunks, and five of them have got 4 bunks.

00:02:38,460

Right. And what other facilities are there?

00:02:41,780

We have separate toilets and showers for each of the rooms. There's a large dining room and a large meeting room which can be booked by groups in advance. But I'm afraid we had a flood in there last month, and the floor was slightly damaged. So unfortunately, it's out of use just now. We've got workmen coming in next week. When were you thinking of staying?

00:03:05,080

In three weeks' time, the twenty-eighth of September.

00:03:08,180

Oh, it should be okay by then.

00:03:10,800

Oh, well, that's okay then. Uh, and what about food? Do you provide meals, or is it self-catering?

00:03:17,500

We're very flexible. As long as you give us enough notice, we can cater for you. Or if you prefer, you can just bring your own food and use the kitchen facilities. And some people prefer to eat out, which is also fine.

00:03:32,920

Fine. And I heard that your farm is organic. Does that mean that you only have crops and no animals?

00:03:39,720

[chuckles] It doesn't actually. A lot of people seem to think that, but we do rear livestock as well, and so we have a wide range of food. Organic means it's all produced without the use of artificial fertilizers or pesticides.

00:03:55,320

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
see. That sounds good. Um, could you tell me what sort of recreational activities are available either at the centre or in the area?

00:04:04,840

Yes. Here at the centre, we offer farm tours. They're very popular. One of the farm managers shows people around and explains some of the principles of organic farming. And for any visitors who are really keen, he'll let them drive a tractor or feed the animals and so on. With supervision, of course.

00:04:25,280

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
think a lot of our group would be interested in that. It'd make a change from factory work.

00:04:30,780

Well, if they fancy it, tell them to come prepared. Plenty of old clothing, especially footwear. It can be very messy and wet.

00:04:39,660

Okay, I'll warn them.

00:04:44,680

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten on page three.

00:04:59,180

Now listen and answer questions five to ten.

00:05:29,180

And another type of activity we do is survival courses, but that's only for groups of five or more. And they've got to be acquaintances. They have to cooperate closely. These courses are very popular, especially with school groups, but adults seem to enjoy them too.

00:05:47,170

What do they involve? Uh, things like map reading?

00:05:50,560

Well, not exactly. What it is: we've got a large area of woodland on the farm, and we run this course there. It's mainly about collecting food and water, um- Lighting a fire without any equipment, that kind of thing.

00:06:07,172

Hmm. This weekend could be hard work. Um, what about the area around the center? What is there to do?

00:06:14,632

If you look at a map, you'll see that we're very well situated here. Our center's about midway between the Exmoor National Park, which is very popular for hill walking, and the South Coast, which has very good beaches.

00:06:28,352

Are they both within walking distance?

00:06:30,652

Well, they're both a bit far u-unless you're very fit, but they're only about thirty minutes by road. And there's also a cycle path which starts quite near here, about ten minutes walk away. You can hire bikes at the starting point.

00:06:45,032

Um, what is there to do if the weather's bad? I hope it won't be, but you never know.

00:06:50,052

Yes, that's right. Well, on most Saturday evenings, we show films here. And then once a month, a group of local musicians performs in our meeting room.

00:06:59,712

Hmm.

00:07:00,932

And then Sherborne is only fourteen miles away. It's only a small town, but it's got a very good museum and an old abbey which is well worth a visit.

00:07:10,272

Well, it sounds perfect for our purposes. Uh, one last thing. What about prices? I'm not sure yet, but there'll probably be about fifteen of us.

00:07:21,232

We charge a standard fourteen pounds a head for accommodation, whether there are ten or twenty of you or whatever, and about seven pounds for cooked meals, depending on the menu you want. Use of the kitchen facilities is extra, as is the hire of the meeting room. It depends really what exactly you want and for how many people.

00:07:43,412

Right. Well, I've made a note of all that, and I'll discuss it with the rest of the group. Then I'll get back to you with a firm booking. Can I do that by phone?

00:07:52,412

Yes, you can, but once you've made a booking, we would need a deposit within five days to secure it. Then you just pay the balance when you're here.

00:08:01,012

Oh, yes, of course. Uh, could you give me the address, please?

00:08:05,872

Yes. It's Winsham Farm,

00:08:09,792

Cotele Road. That's C-O-T-E-H-E-L-E, near Sherborne. And the postcode is SH121LQ.

00:08:25,692

Thank you.

00:08:29,672

That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
